# Loan Studio

> Loan Studio is an Australian mortgage and finance brokerage helping clients across Melbourne and Australia with residential, commercial and specialist lending. The team provides support across home loans, refinancing, first home buyer finance, investment lending, commercial finance, SMSF lending, renovation finance, asset finance and specialist lending for professionals.

Loan Studio has a particular specialty in construction finance and supports borrowers planning new builds, house and land packages, knockdown rebuilds, major renovations, investment property construction and other eligible construction projects.

Loan Studio is based in Fitzroy, Melbourne and supports clients Australia-wide. The business has operated since 2011 and has assisted more than 40,000 clients.

- [Contact Loan Studio](https://loanstudio.com.au/contact/): Contact and enquiry information.

## Construction Finance Specialty

Construction lending is a major area of expertise for Loan Studio.

Unlike a standard home loan, construction finance generally involves staged funding, builder payment schedules, valuations, documentation requirements and lender-specific construction policies.

Loan Studio supports clients throughout the construction finance process, including:

- Reviewing the client's financial position
- Assessing land ownership or proposed land purchase
- Reviewing the construction budget
- Reviewing deposit or available equity
- Assessing borrowing capacity
- Comparing suitable construction lenders
- Reviewing lender construction policies
- Structuring the construction loan
- Coordinating building contracts and supporting documents
- Managing lender valuation requirements
- Explaining progress payment stages
- Assisting with construction drawdowns
- Supporting clients when variations or additional costs arise
- Following up lender queries
- Assisting through final completion and final drawdown

Loan Studio works with a panel of more than 50 bank, non-bank and specialist lenders and compares suitable construction finance options based on the borrower, project type, funding position and lender requirements.

## Types of Construction Projects

Loan Studio can assist with a range of eligible construction scenarios, including:

- New home construction
- House and land packages
- Land and construction finance
- Knockdown and rebuild projects
- Major home renovations
- Structural extensions
- Investment property construction
- Selected commercial construction projects
- Projects involving existing property equity
- Construction finance involving complex funding structures

Suitability depends on the borrower, project, builder, contract, property, lender policy and overall financial position.

## Construction Loan Process

Loan Studio's general construction lending process may include:

1. Understanding the proposed construction project.
2. Reviewing the land position, building contract and total project costs.
3. Assessing income, existing debts, deposit and available equity.
4. Reviewing borrowing capacity.
5. Comparing suitable lenders and construction loan policies.
6. Structuring the loan around the project.
7. Preparing and submitting the application.
8. Coordinating required building and financial documents.
9. Working through lender valuation and approval requirements.
10. Supporting the borrower with progress payment requests.
11. Assisting with lender queries during construction.
12. Supporting the final drawdown and completion stage.

## Construction Progress Payments

Construction loans are generally released progressively as the build reaches agreed stages.

Common construction stages may include:

- Deposit or initial stage
- Slab or base
- Frame
- Lock-up
- Fixing
- Completion

The exact stages depend on the building contract and lender requirements.

Loan Studio helps borrowers understand:

- What documents may be required for each progress claim
- How lender inspections or valuations may work
- When builder invoices are submitted
- How funds are released
- What happens if there are variations
- How additional costs may affect the finance
- What is required at final completion

Interest on a construction loan is generally calculated on the amount already drawn rather than the full approved facility from the start, subject to the lender and loan structure.

## Construction Finance Considerations

Important factors that may affect a construction loan include:

- Land ownership
- Land purchase price
- Current land value
- Existing property debt
- Building contract amount
- Fixed-price contract requirements
- Builder eligibility
- Site costs
- Demolition costs
- Upgrades
- Variations
- Landscaping
- Additional works outside the main contract
- Available deposit
- Existing property equity
- Borrowing capacity
- Construction timeline
- Progress payment schedule
- Lender valuation
- Construction period limits
- Lender policy

Loan Studio can help identify these considerations before the construction application is submitted.

## Common Construction Lending Challenges

Loan Studio assists clients where construction lending becomes more complex.

Examples may include:

- Lower-than-expected valuations
- Building costs increasing
- Contract variations
- Insufficient contingency funds
- Delays in construction
- Progress payment delays
- Lender policy restrictions
- Existing property debt
- Using equity to fund construction
- Land settlement occurring before construction
- Complex income structures
- Self-employed borrowers
- Construction applications that have previously been declined

Alternative lending options depend on individual circumstances and lender policy and cannot be guaranteed.

## Lending Network

Loan Studio works with a panel of more than 50 lenders.

The lender panel includes major banks, non-bank lenders and specialist lenders.

The lender panel allows Loan Studio brokers to assess different lending policies rather than being restricted to the products of a single bank.

Lender availability, loan products, interest rates, fees, borrowing capacity and approval criteria depend on current lender policy and individual borrower circumstances.

## Loan Process

Loan Studio's general mortgage broking process may include:

## Important Information

Every borrower's financial position is different.

Loan availability, interest rates, borrowing capacity, loan-to-value ratios, fees, lender policies and approval criteria depend on individual circumstances and lender assessment.

Construction finance options also depend on factors including:

- Property and land value
- Building contract
- Builder
- Project type
- Construction budget
- Deposit
- Available equity
- Borrowing capacity
- Construction timeline
- Lender construction policy

Information published by Loan Studio is general in nature and does not take into account an individual's personal objectives, financial circumstances or needs.

Clients should seek professional financial, legal, taxation or other specialist advice where appropriate.
